transliteration: Nisfahooo awinqus minhu qaleelaa
translation: of one-half thereof - or make it a little less than that,

arabic: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا
transliteration: Aw zid 'alaihi wa rattilil Qur'aana tarteela
translation: or add to it [at will]; and [during that time] recite the Qur’an calmly and distinctly, with thy mind attuned to its meaning.

arabic: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًۭا ثَقِيلًا
transliteration: Innaa sanulqee 'alika qawalan saqeelaa
translation: Behold, We shall bestow upon thee a weighty message –

arabic: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًۭٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
transliteration: Inn naashi'atal laili hiya ashadddu wat anw wa aqwamu qeelaa
translation: [and,] verily, the hours of night the mind most strongly and speak with the clearest voice,

arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًۭا طَوِيلًۭا
transliteration: Inna laka fin nahaari sabhan taweelaa
translation: whereas by day a long chain of doings is thy portion.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًۭا
transliteration: Wazkuris ma rabbika wa tabattal ilaihi tabteelaa
translation: But [whether by night or by day,] remember thy Sustainer's name, and devote thyself unto Him with utter devotion.

arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًۭا
transliteration: Rabbul mashriqi wal maghriibi laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa fattakhizhu wakeelaa
translation: The Sustainer of the east and the west [is He]: there is no deity save Him: hence, ascribe to Him alone the power to determine thy fate,

arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًۭا جَمِيلًۭا
transliteration: Wasbir 'alaa maa yaqoo loona wahjurhum hajran jameelaa
translation: and endure with patience whatever people may say [against thee], and avoid them with a comely avoidance.

arabic: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
transliteration: Wa zarnee walmukaz zibeena ulin na'mati wa mahhilhum qaleelaa
translation: And leave Me alone [to deal] with those who give the lie to the truth - those who enjoy the blessings of life [without any thought of God] - and bear thou with them for a little while:

arabic: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًۭا وَجَحِيمًۭا
transliteration: Inna ladainaaa ankaalanw wa jaheemaa
translation: for, behold, heavy fetters [await them] with Us, and a blazing fire,

arabic: وَطَعَامًۭا ذَا غُصَّةٍۢ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
transliteration: Wa ta'aaman zaa ghussa tinw wa'azaaban aleemaa
translation: and food that chokes, and grievous suffering

arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًۭا مَّهِيلًا
transliteration: Yawma tarjuful ardu waljibaalu wa kaanatil jibaalu kaseebam maheelaa
translation: on the Day when the earth and the mountains will be convulsed and the mountains will [crumble and] become like a sand-dune on the move!

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًۭا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًۭا
transliteration: Innaa arsalnaaa ilaikum rasoolan shahidan 'alikum kamaaa arsalnaaa ilaa Fir'awna Rasoolna
translation: BEHOLD, [O men,] We have sent unto you an apostle who shall bear witness to the truth before you, even as We sent an apostle unto Pharaoh:

arabic: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ أَخْذًۭا وَبِيلًۭا
transliteration: Fa'asaa Fir'awnur Rasoola fa akhaznaahu akhzanw wabeelaa
translation: and Pharaoh rebelled against the apostle, whereupon We took him to task with a crushing grip.

arabic: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًۭا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
transliteration: Fakaifa tattaqoona in kafartum yawmany yaj'alul wildaana sheeba
translation: How, then, if you refuse to acknowledge the truth, will you protect yourselves on that Day which shall turn the hair of children grey,

arabic: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
transliteration: Assamaaa'u munfatirum bih; kaana wa'duhoo maf'oola
translation: [the Day] on which the skies shall be rent asunder, [and] His promise [of resurrection] fulfilled?

arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
transliteration: Inna haazihee tazkiratun fa man shaaa'at takhaza ilaa Rabbihee sabeelaa
translation: This, verily, is a reminder: let him who wills, then set out on a way to his Sustainer!

arabic: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍۢ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًۭا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًۭا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۢ
transliteration: Inna Rabbaka ya'lamu annaka taqoomu adnaa min sulusa yil laili wa nisfahoo wa sulusahoo wa taaa'ifatum minal lazeena ma'ak; wal laahu yuqaddirul laila wanna haar; 'alima al lan tuhsoohu fataaba 'alaikum faqra'oo maa tayassara minal quraan; 'alima an sa yakoonu minkum mardaa wa aakharoona yadriboona fil ardi yabtaghoona min fadlil laahi wa aakharoona yuqaatiloona fee sabeelil laahi faqra'oo ma tayassara minhu wa aqeemus salaata wa aatuz zakaata wa aqridul laaha qardan hasanaa; wa maa tuqadimoo li anfusikum min khairin tajidoohu 'indal laahi huwa khayranw wa a'zama ajraa; wastaghfirul laahaa innal laaha ghafoorur raheem.
translation: BEHOLD, [O Prophet,] thy Sustainer knows that thou keepest awake [in prayer] nearly two-thirds of the night, or one-half of it, or a third of it, together with some of those who follow thee. And God who determines the measure of night and day, is aware that you would never grudge it: and therefore He turns towards you in His grace. Recite, then, as much of the Qur’an as you may do with ease. He knows that in time there will be among you sick people, and others who will go about the land in search of God's bounty, and others who will fight in God’s cause. Recite, then, [only] as much of it as you may do with ease, and be constant in prayer, and spend in charity, and [thus] lend unto God a goodly loan: for whatever good deed you may offer up in your own behalf, you shall truly find it with God - yea, better, and richer in reward. And [always] seek God's forgiveness: behold, God is much-forgiving, a dispenser of grace!

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ
transliteration: Yaaa ayyuhal muddassir
translation: O THOU [in thy solitude] enfolded!

arabic: قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ
transliteration: Qum fa anzir
translation: Arise and warn!

arabic: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ
transliteration: Wa rabbaka fakabbir
translation: And thy Sustainer's greatness glorify!

arabic: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ
transliteration: Wa siyaabaka fatahhir
translation: And thine inner self purify!

arabic: وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ
transliteration: Warrujza fahjur
translation: And all defilement shun!

arabic: وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ
transliteration: Wa laa tamnun tastaksir
translation: And do not through giving seek thyself to gain,

arabic: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ
transliteration: Wa li Rabbika fasbir
translation: but unto thy Sustainer turn in patience.

arabic: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ
transliteration: Fa izaa nuqira fin naaqoor
translation: And [warn all men that] when the trumpet-call [of resurrection] is sounded,

arabic: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ
transliteration: Fazaalika yawma 'iziny yawmun 'aseer
translation: that very Day shall be a day of anguish,

arabic: عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍۢ
transliteration: 'Alal kaafireena ghayru yaseer
translation: not of ease, for all who [now] deny the truth!

arabic: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًۭا
transliteration: Zamee wa man khalaqtu waheedaa
translation: LEAVE Me alone [to deal] with him whom I have created alone,

arabic: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًۭا مَّمْدُودًۭا
transliteration: Wa ja'altu lahoo maalam mamdoodaa
translation: and to whom I have granted resources vast,

arabic: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًۭا
transliteration: Wa baneena shuhoodaa
translation: and children as [love's] witnesses,

arabic: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًۭا
transliteration: Wa mahhattu lahoo tamheeda
translation: and to whose life I gave so wide a scope:

arabic: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
transliteration: Summa yat ma'u an azeed
translation: and yet, he greedily desires that I give yet more!

arabic: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِءَايَٰتِنَا عَنِيدًۭا
transliteration: Kallaaa innahoo kaana li Aayaatinaa 'aneedaa
translation: Nay, verily, it is against Our messages that he knowingly, stubbornly sets himself

arabic: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
transliteration: Sa urhiquhoo sa'oodaa
translation: [and so] I shall constrain him to endure a painful uphill climb!

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
transliteration: Innahoo fakkara wa qaddar
translation: Behold, [when Our messages are conveyed to one who is bent on denying the truth,] he reflects and meditates [as to how to disprove them] –

arabic: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
transliteration: Faqutila kayfa qaddar
translation: and thus he destroys himself, the way he meditates:

arabic: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
transliteration: Summa qutila kaifa qaddar
translation: yea, he destroys himself, the way he meditates!

arabic: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
transliteration: Summa nazar
translation: and then he looks [around for new arguments],

arabic: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
transliteration: Summa 'abasa wa basar
translation: and then he frowns and glares,

arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
transliteration: Summaa adbara wastakbar
translation: and in the end he turns his back [on Our message], and glories in his arrogance,

arabic: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ يُؤْثَرُ
transliteration: Faqaala in haazaaa illaa sihruny yu'sar
translation: and says, "All this is mere spellbinding eloquence handed down [from olden times]!

arabic: إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ
transliteration: In haazaaa illaa qawlul bashar
translation: This is nothing but the word of mortal man!"

arabic: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ
transliteration: Sa usleehi saqar
translation: [Hence,] I shall cause him to endure hell-fire [in the life to come]!

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ
transliteration: Wa maaa adraaka maa saqar
translation: And what could make thee conceive what hell-fire is?

arabic: لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ
transliteration: Laa tubqee wa laa tazar
translation: It does not allow to live, and neither leaves [to die],

arabic: لَوَّاحَةٌۭ لِّلْبَشَرِ
transliteration: Lawwaahatul lilbashar
translation: making [all truth] visible to mortal man.

arabic: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ
transliteration: 'Alaihaa tis'ata 'ashar
translation: Over it are nineteen [powers].

arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًۭا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
transliteration: Wa maaja''alnaaa As haaban naari illaa malaaa 'ikatanw wa maa ja'alnaa 'iddatahum illaa fitnatal lillazeena kafaroo liyastayqinal lazeena ootul kitaaba wa yazdaadal lazeena aamanooo eemaananw wa laa yartaabal lazeena ootul kitaaba walmu'minoona wa liyaqoolal lazeena fee quloo bihim maradunw walkaafiroona maazaaa araadal laahu bihaazaa masalaa; kazaalika yudillul laahu many yashaaa'u wa yahdee many yashaaa'; wa maa ya'lamu junooda rabbika illaa hoo; wa maa hiya illaa zikraa lil bashar
translation: For We have caused none but angelic powers to lord over the fire [of hell]; and We have not caused their number to be aught but a trial for those who are bent on denying the truth - to the end that they who have been granted revelation aforetime might be convinced [of the truth of this divine writ]; and that they who have attained to faith [in it] might grow yet more firm in their faith; and that [both] they who have been granted the earlier revelation and they who believe [in this one] might be freed of all doubt; and that they in whose hearts is disease and the who deny the truth outright might ask, "What does [your] God mean by this parable?" In this way God lets go astray him that wills [to go astray], and guides aright him that wills [to be guided]. And none can comprehend thy Sustainers forces save Him alone: and all this is but a reminder to mortal man.

arabic: كَلَّا وَٱلْقَمَرِ
transliteration: Kallaa walqamar
translation: NAY, but consider the moon!

arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ
transliteration: Wallaili adbar
translation: Consider the night when it departs,

arabic: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ
transliteration: Wassub hi izaaa asfar
translation: and the morn when it dawns!

arabic: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ
transliteration: Innahaa la ihdal kubar
translation: Verily, that [hell-fire) is Indeed one of the great [forewarnings] –

arabic: نَذِيرًۭا لِّلْبَشَرِ
transliteration: Nazeeral lilbashar
translation: a warning to mortal man –

arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
transliteration: Liman shaaa'a minkum any yataqaddama aw yata akhkhar
translation: to everyone of you, whether he chooses to come forward or to hang back!

arabic: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ
transliteration: Kullu nafsim bim kasabat raheenah
translation: [On the Day of Judgment,] every human being will be held in pledge for whatever [evil] he has wrought –

arabic: إِلَّآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ
transliteration: Illaaa as haabal yameen
translation: save those who shall have attained to righteousness:

arabic: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
transliteration: Fee jannaatiny yata saaa'aloon
translation: [dwelling] In gardens [of paradise], they will inquire

arabic: عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
transliteration: 'Anil mujrimeen
translation: of those who were lost in sin:

arabic: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ
transliteration: Maa salakakum fee saqar
translation: "What has brought you into hell-fire?"

arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
transliteration: Qaaloo lam naku minal musalleen
translation: They will answer: "We were not among those who prayed;

arabic: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ
transliteration: Wa lam naku nut'imul miskeen
translation: and neither did we feed the needy;

arabic: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ
transliteration: Wa kunnaa nakhoodu ma'al khaaa'ideen
translation: and we were wont to indulge in sinning together with all [the others] who indulged in it;

arabic: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
transliteration: Wa kunnaa nukazzibu bi yawmid Deen
translation: and the Day of Judgment we were wont to call a lie –

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
transliteration: Hattaaa ataanal yaqeen
translation: until certainty came upon us [in death]."

arabic: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَٰعَةُ ٱلشَّٰفِعِينَ
transliteration: Famaa tanfa'uhum shafaa'atush shaafi'een
translation: And so, of no benefit to them could be the intercession of any that would intercede for them.

arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
transliteration: Famaa lahum 'anittazkirati mu'rideen
translation: WHAT, THEN, is amiss with them that they turn away from all admonition

arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌۭ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌۭ
transliteration: Ka annahum humurum mustanfirah
translation: as though they were terrified asses

arabic: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
transliteration: Farrat min qaswarah
translation: fleeing from a lion?

arabic: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًۭا مُّنَشَّرَةًۭ
transliteration: Bal yureedu kullum ri'im minhum any yu'taa suhufam munashsharah
translation: Yea, everyone of them claims that he [himself] ought to have been given revelations unfolded!

arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
transliteration: Kallaa bal laa yakhaafoonal aakhirah
translation: Nay, but they do not [believe in and, hence, do not] fear the life to come.

arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ
transliteration: Kallaaa innahoo tazkirah
translation: Nay, verily, this is an admonition –

arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
transliteration: Fa man shaaa'a zakarah
translation: and whoever wills may take it to heart.

arabic: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
transliteration: Wa maa yazkuroona illaaa any yashaaa'al laah; Huwa ahlut taqwaa wa ahlul maghfirah
translation: But they [who do not believe in the life to come] will not take it to heart unless God so wills: [for] He is the Fount of all God-consciousness, and the Fount of all forgiveness.

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
transliteration: Laaa uqsimu bi yawmil qiyaamah
translation: NAY! I call to witness the Day of Resurrection!

arabic: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
transliteration: Wa laaa uqsimu bin nafsil lawwaamah
translation: But nay! I call to witness the accusing voice of man's own conscience!

arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
transliteration: Ayahsabul insaanu al lan najm'a 'izaamah
translation: Does man think that We cannot [resurrect him and] bring his bones together again?

arabic: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
transliteration: Balaa qaadireena 'alaaa an nusawwiya banaanah
translation: Yea indeed, We are able to make whole his very finger-tips!

arabic: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
transliteration: Bal yureedul insaanu liyafjura amaamah
translation: None the less man chooses to deny what lies ahead of him,

arabic: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
transliteration: Yas'alu ayyyaana yawmul qiyaamah
translation: asking [derisively], "When is that Resurrection Day to be?"

arabic: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
transliteration: Fa izaa bariqal basar
translation: But [on that Day,] when the eyesight is by fear confounded,

arabic: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
transliteration: We khasafal qamar
translation: and the moon is darkened,

arabic: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
transliteration: Wa jumi'ash shamusu wal qamar
translation: and the sun and the moon are brought together

arabic: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
transliteration: Yaqoolul insaanu yaw ma 'izin aynal mafarr
translation: on that Day will man exclaim "Whither to flee?"

arabic: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
transliteration: Kallaa laa wazar
translation: But nay: no refuge [for thee, O man]!

arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
transliteration: Ilaa rabbika yawma 'izinil mustaqarr
translation: With thy Sustainer, on that Day, the journey's end will be!

arabic: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
transliteration: Yunabba 'ul insaanu yawma 'izim bimaa qaddama wa akhkhar
translation: Man will be apprised, on that Day, of what he has done and what he has left undone:

arabic: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌۭ
transliteration: Balil insaanu 'alaa nafsihee baseerah
translation: nay, but man shall against himself be an eye-witness,

arabic: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
transliteration: Wa law alqaa ma'aazeerah
translation: even though he may veil himself in excuses.

arabic: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
transliteration: Laa tuharrik bihee lisaa naka lita'jala bih
translation: MOVE NOT thy tongue in haste, [repeating the words of the revelation:]

arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
transliteration: Inna 'alainaa jam'ahoo wa qur aanah
translation: for, behold, it is for Us to gather it [in thy heart,] and to cause it to be read [as it ought to be read].

arabic: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
transliteration: Fa izaa qaraanaahu fattabi' qur aanah
translation: Thus, when We recite it, follow thou its wording [with all thy mind]:

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
transliteration: Summa inna 'alainaa bayaanah
translation: and then, behold, it will be for Us to make its meaning clear.

arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
transliteration: Kallaa bal tuhibboonal 'aajilah
translation: NAY, but [most of] you love this fleeting life,

arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
transliteration: Wa tazaroonal Aakhirah
translation: and give no thought to the life to come [and to Judgment Day]!

arabic: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاضِرَةٌ
transliteration: Wujoohuny yawma 'izin naadirah
translation: Some faces will on that Day be bright with happiness,

arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌۭ
transliteration: Ilaa rabbihaa naazirah
translation: looking up to their Sustainer;

arabic: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌۭ
transliteration: Wa wujoohuny yawma 'izim baasirah
translation: and some faces will on that Day be overcast with despair,

arabic: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌۭ
transliteration: Tazunnu any yuf'ala bihaa faaqirah
translation: knowing that a crushing calamity is about to befall them.

arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
transliteration: Kallaaa izaa balaghatit taraaqee
translation: NAY, but when [the last breath] comes up to the throat [of a dying man],

arabic: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍۢ
transliteration: Wa qeela man raaq
translation: and people ask, "Is there any wizard [that could save him]?"

arabic: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
transliteration: Wa zanna annahul firaaq
translation: the while he [himself] knows that this is the parting,

arabic: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
transliteration: Waltaffatis saaqu bissaaq
translation: and is enwrapped in the pangs of death

arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
transliteration: Ilaa rabbika yawma'izinil masaaq
translation: at that time towards thy Sustainer does he feel impelled to turn!

arabic: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
transliteration: Falaa saddaqa wa laa sallaa
translation: [Useless, though, will be his repentance: for [as long as he was alive] he did not accept the truth, nor did he pray [for enlightenment],

arabic: وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
transliteration: Wa laakin kazzaba wa tawalla
translation: but, on the contrary, he gave the lie to the truth and turned away [from it],

arabic: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
transliteration: Summa zahaba ilaaa ahlihee yatamatta
translation: and then went arrogantly back to what he had come from.

arabic: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
transliteration: Awlaa laka fa awlaa
translation: [And yet, O man, thine end comes hourly] nearer unto thee, and nearer –

arabic: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
transliteration: Summa awlaa laka fa awla
translation: and ever nearer unto thee, and nearer!

arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
transliteration: Ayahsabul insaanu anyytraka sudaa
translation: DOES MAN, then, think that he is to be left to himself to go about at will?

arabic: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةًۭ مِّن مَّنِىٍّۢ يُمْنَىٰ
transliteration: Alam yaku nutfatam mim maniyyiny yumnaa
translation: Was he not once a [mere] drop of sperm that had been spilt,

arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
transliteration: Summa kaana 'alaqata fakhalaq fasawwaa
translation: and thereafter became a germ-cell - whereupon He created and formed [it] in accordance with what [it] was meant to be,

arabic: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
transliteration: Faja'ala minhuz zawjayniz zakara wal unsaa
translation: and fashioned out of it the two sexes, the male and the female?

arabic: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
transliteration: Alaisa zaalika biqaadirin 'alaaa any yuhyiyal mawtaa
translation: Is not He, then; able to bring the dead back to life?

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا
transliteration: Hal ataa 'alal insaani heenum minad dahri lam yakun shai'am mazkooraa
translation: HAS THERE [not] been an endless span of time before man [appeared - a time] when he was not yet a thing to be thought of?

arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
transliteration: Innaa khalaqnal insaana min nutfatin amshaajin nabta leehi faja'alnaahu samee'am baseeraa
translation: Verily, it is We who have created man out of a drop of sperm intermingled, so that We might try him [in his later life]: and therefore We made him a being endowed with hearing and sight.

arabic: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًۭا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
transliteration: Innaa hadainaahus sabeela immaa shaakiranw wa immaa kafoora
translation: Verily, We have shown him the way: [and it rests with him to prove himself] either grateful or ungrateful.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًۭا وَسَعِيرًا
transliteration: Innaaa a'tadnaa lilkaa fireena salaasila wa aghlaalanw wa sa'eeraa
translation: [Now,] behold, for those who deny the truth We have readied chains and shackles, and a blazing flame

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍۢ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
transliteration: innal abraara yashra boona min kaasin kaana mizaa juhaa kaafooraa
translation: [whereas,] behold, the truly virtuous shall drink from a cup flavoured with the calyx of sweet-smelling flowers:

arabic: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًۭا
transliteration: 'Aynany yashrabu bihaa 'ibaadul laahi yafajjiroonahaa tafjeeraa
translation: a source [of bliss] whereof God's servants shall drink, seeing it flow in a flow abundant.

arabic: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًۭا
transliteration: Yoofoona binnazri wa yakhaafoona yawman kaana sharruhoo mustateeraa
translation: [The truly virtuous are] they [who] fulfil their vows, and stand in awe of a Day the woe of which is bound to spread far and wide,

arabic: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًۭا وَيَتِيمًۭا وَأَسِيرًا
transliteration: Wa yut''imoonat ta'aama 'alaa hubbihee miskeenanw wa yatemanw wa aseeraa
translation: and who give food - however great be their own want of it - unto the needy, and the orphan, and the captive,

arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَلَا شُكُورًا
transliteration: Innaamaa nut'imukum li wajhil laahi laa nureedu minkum jazaaa'anw wa laa shukooraa
translation: [saying, in their hearts,] "We feed you for the sake of God alone: we desire no recompense from you, nor thanks:

arabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًۭا قَمْطَرِيرًۭا
transliteration: Innaa nakhaafu mir Rabbinna Yawman 'aboosan qamtareeraa
translation: behold, we stand in awe of our Sustainer's judgment on a distressful, fateful Day!"

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةًۭ وَسُرُورًۭا
transliteration: Fa waqaahumul laahu sharra zaalikal yawmi wa laqqaahum nadratanw wa surooraa
translation: And so, God will preserve them from the woes of that Day, and will bestow on them brightness and joy,

arabic: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةًۭ وَحَرِيرًۭا
transliteration: Wa jazaahum bimaa sabaroo janatanw wa hareeraa
translation: and will reward them for all their patience in adversity with a garden [of bliss] and with [garments of] silk.

arabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًۭا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًۭا
transliteration: muttaki'eena feeha 'alal araaa 'iki laa yarawna feehaa shamsanw wa laa zamhareeraa
translation: In that [garden] they will on couches recline, and will know therein neither [burning] sun nor cold severe,

arabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًۭا
transliteration: Wa daaniyatan 'alaihim zilaaluhaa wa zullilat qutoofu haa tazleela
translation: since its [blissful] shades will come down low over them, and low will hang down its clusters of fruit, most easy to reach.

arabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍۢ مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
transliteration: Wa yutaafu 'alaihim bi aaniyatim min fiddatinw wa akwaabin kaanat qawaareeraa
translation: And they will be waited upon with vessels of silver and goblets that will [seem to] be crystal –

arabic: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًۭا
transliteration: Qawaareera min fiddatin qaddaroohaa taqdeeraa
translation: crystal-like, [but] of silver - the measure whereof they alone will determine.

arabic: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
transliteration: Wa yusawna feehaa kaasan kaana mizaajuhaa zanjabeelaa
translation: And in that [paradise] they will be given to drink of a cup flavoured with ginger,

arabic: عَيْنًۭا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًۭا
transliteration: 'Aynan feeha tusammaa salsabeelaa
translation: [derived from] a source [to be found] therein, whose name is "Seek Thy Way".

arabic: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًۭا مَّنثُورًۭا
transliteration: Wa yatoofu 'alaihim wildaanum mukhalladoona izaa ra aytahum hasibtahum lu'lu 'am mansoora
translation: And immortal youths will wait upon them: when thou seest them, thou wouldst deem them to be scattered pearls;

arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًۭا وَمُلْكًۭا كَبِيرًا
transliteration: Wa izaa ra ayta summa ra ayta na'eemanw wa mulkan kabeera
translation: and when thou seest [anything that is] there thou wilt see [only] bliss and a realm transcendent

arabic: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا
transliteration: 'Aaliyahum siyaabu sundusin khudrunw wa istabraq, wa hullooo asaawira min fiddatinw wa saqaahum Rabbuhum sharaaban tahooraa
translation: Upon those [blest] will be garments of green silk and brocade; and they will be adorned with bracelets of silver. And their Sustainer will them to drink of a drink most pure.

arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
transliteration: Innaa haazaa kaana lakum jazz 'anw wa kaana sa'yukum mashkooraa
translation: [And they will be told:] "Verily, all this is your reward since Your endeavour [in life] has met [God's] goodly acceptance!"

arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا
transliteration: Innaa nahnu nazzalnaa 'alaikal quraana tanzeelaa
translation: VERILY, [O believer,] it is We who have bestowed from on high this Qur’an upon thee, step by step - truly a bestowal from on high!

arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا
transliteration: Fasbir lihukmi Rabbika wa laa tuti' minhum aasiman aw kafooraa
translation: Await, then, in all patience thy Sustainer's judgment, and pay no heed to any of them, who is a wilful sinner or an ingrate;

arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًۭا
transliteration: Wazkuris ma Rabbika bukratanw wa aseelaa
translation: and bear in mind thy Sustainer's name at morn and evening

arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًۭا طَوِيلًا
transliteration: Wa minal laili fasjud lahoo wa sabbihhu lailan taweelaa
translation: and during some of the night, and prostrate thyself before Him, and extol His limitless glory throughout the long night.

arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا
transliteration: Inna haaa'ulaa'i yuhibboona 'aajilata wa yazaroona waraaa'ahum yawman saqeelaa
translation: Behold, they [who are unmindful of God] love this fleeting life, and leave behind them [all thought of] a grief-laden Day.

arabic: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
transliteration: Nahnu khalaqnaahum wa shadadnaaa asrahum wa izaa shi'naa baddalnaaa amsaala hum tabdeelaa
translation: [They will not admit to themselves that] it We who have created them and strengthened their make - and [that] if it be Our will We can replace them entirely with others of their kind.

arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا
transliteration: Inna haazihee tazkiratun fa man shaaa'at takhaza ilaa rabbihee sabeela
translation: VERILY, all this is an admonition: whoever, then, so wills, may unto his Sustainer find a way.

arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا
transliteration: Wa maa tashaaa'oona illaa anyyashaaa'al laah; innal laahaa kaana'Aleeman Hakeema
translation: But you cannot will it unless God wills [to show you that way]: for, behold, God is indeed all-seeing, wise.

arabic: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
transliteration: Yudkhilu mai yashaaa'u fee rahmatih; wazzaalimeena a'adda lahum 'azaaban aleemaa
translation: He admits unto His grace everyone who wills [to be admitted]; but as for the evildoers - for them has He readied grievous suffering [in the life to come].

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ عُرْفًۭا
transliteration: Wal mursalaati'urfaa
translation: CONSIDER these [messages,] sent forth in waves

arabic: فَٱلْعَٰصِفَٰتِ عَصْفًۭا
transliteration: Fal'aasifaati 'asfaa
translation: and then storming on with a tempest's force!

arabic: وَٱلنَّٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًۭا
transliteration: Wannaashiraati nashraa
translation: Consider these [messages] that spread [the truth] far and wide,

arabic: فَٱلْفَٰرِقَٰتِ فَرْقًۭا
transliteration: Falfaariqaati farqaa
translation: thus separating [right and wrong] with all clarity,

arabic: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا
transliteration: Falmulqiyaati zikra
translation: and then giving forth a reminder,

arabic: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
transliteration: 'Uzran aw nuzraa
translation: [promising] freedom from blame or [offering] a warning!

arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
transliteration: Innamaa too'adoona lawaaqi'
translation: BEHOLD, all that you are told to expect will surely come to pass.

arabic: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
transliteration: Fa izam nujoomu tumisat
translation: Thus, [it will come to pass] when the stars are effaced,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
transliteration: Wa izas samaaa'u furijat
translation: and when the sky is rent asunder,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
transliteration: Wa izal jibaalu nusifat
translation: and when the mountains are scattered like dust,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
transliteration: Wa izar Rusulu uqqitat
translation: and when all the apostles are called together at a time appointed...

arabic: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
transliteration: Li ayyi yawmin ujjilat
translation: For what day has the term [of all this] been set?

arabic: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
transliteration: Li yawmil Fasl
translation: For the Day of Distinction [between the true and the false]!

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
transliteration: Wa maaa adraaka maa yawmul fasl
translation: And what could make thee conceive what that Day of Distinction will be?

arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
transliteration: Wailuny yawma 'izillilmukazzibeen
translation: Woe on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth!

arabic: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
transliteration: Alam nuhlikil awwaleen
translation: Did We not destroy [so many of] those [sinners] of olden days?

arabic: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
transliteration: Summa nutbi'uhumul aakhireen
translation: And We shall let them be followed by those of later times:

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
transliteration: Kazzlika naf'alu bilmujrimeen
translation: [for] thus do We deal with such as are lost in sin.

arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
transliteration: Wailunw yawma 'izil lil mukazzibeen
translation: Woe on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth!

arabic: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍۢ مَّهِينٍۢ
transliteration: Alam nakhlukkum mimmaaa'im maheen
translation: Did We not create you out of a humble fluid

arabic: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍ
transliteration: Faja'alnaahu fee qaraarim makeen
translation: which We then let remain in [the womb's] firm keeping

arabic: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
transliteration: Illaa qadrim ma'loom
translation: for a term pre-ordained?

arabic: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَٰدِرُونَ
transliteration: Faqadarnaa fani'mal qaadiroon
translation: Thus have We determined [the nature of man's creation]: and excellent indeed is Our power to determine [what is to be]!

arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
transliteration: Wailuny yawma 'izil lilmukazzibeen
translation: Woe, on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth!

arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا
transliteration: Alam naj'alil arda kifaataa
translation: Have We not caused the earth to hold within itself

arabic: أَحْيَآءًۭ وَأَمْوَٰتًۭا
transliteration: Ahyaaa'anw wa amwaataa
translation: the living and the dead?

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَٰمِخَٰتٍۢ وَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُم مَّآءًۭ فُرَاتًۭا
transliteration: Wa ja'alnaa feehaa rawaasiya shaamikhaatinw wa asqainaakum maaa'an furaataa
translation: and have We not set on it proud, firm mountains, and given you sweet water to drink?

arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
transliteration: Wailuny yawma 'izil lilmukazzibeen
translation: Woe on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth!

arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
transliteration: Intaliqooo ilaa maa kuntum bihee tukazziboon
translation: GO ON towards that [resurrection] which you were wont to call a lie!

arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّۢ ذِى ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٍۢ
transliteration: Intaliqooo ilaa zillin zee salaasi shu'ab
translation: Go on towards the threefold shadow

arabic: لَّا ظَلِيلٍۢ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
transliteration: Laa zaleelinw wa laa yughnee minal lahab
translation: that will offer no [cooling] shade and will be of no avail against the flame

arabic: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِى بِشَرَرٍۢ كَٱلْقَصْرِ
transliteration: Innahaa tarmee bishararin kalqasr
translation: which – behold!- will throw up sparks like [burning] logs,

arabic: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَٰلَتٌۭ صُفْرٌۭ
transliteration: Ka annahoo jimaalatun sufr
translation: like giant fiery ropes!

arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
transliteration: Wailuny yawma 'izil lilmukazibeen
translation: Woe on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth –

arabic: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
transliteration: Haazaa yawmu laa uantiqoon
translation: that Day on which they will not [be able to] utter a word,

arabic: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa laa yu'zanu lahum fa ya'taziroon
translation: nor be allowed to proffer excuses!

arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
transliteration: Wailunw yawma 'izil lilmukazzibeen
translation: Woe on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth –

arabic: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
transliteration: Haaza yawmul fasli jama 'naakum wal awwaleen
translation: that Day of Distinction [between the true and the false, when they will be told]: "We have brought you together with those [sinners] of olden times;

arabic: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌۭ فَكِيدُونِ
transliteration: Fa in kaana lakum kaidun fakeedoon
translation: and if you [think that you] have a subterfuge left, try to outwit Me!"

arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
transliteration: Wailuny yawma'izil lilmukazzibeen
translation: Woe on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth!

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَٰلٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
transliteration: Innal muttaqeena fee zilaalinw wa 'uyoon
translation: [AS AGAINST this,] behold, the God-conscious shall dwell amidst [cooling] shades and springs,

arabic: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
transliteration: Wa fawaakiha mimmaa yastahoon
translation: and [partake of] whatever fruit they may desire;

arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
transliteration: Kuloo washraboo haneee 'am bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
translation: [and they will be told:] "Eat and drink in good cheer in return for what you did [in life]!"

arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
transliteration: Innaa kazaalika najzil muhsineen
translation: Thus, behold, do We reward the doers of good;

arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
transliteration: Wailuny yawma 'izil lilmuzkazzibeen
translation: [but] woe on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth!

arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
transliteration: Kuloo wa tamatta'oo qaleelan innakum mujrimoon
translation: EAT [your fill] and enjoy your life for a little while, O you who are lost in sin!

arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
transliteration: Wailunny yawma 'izil lilmukazzibeen
translation: [But] woe on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth,

arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
transliteration: Wa izaa qeela lahumur ka'oo aa yarka'oon
translation: and when they are told, "Bow down [before God]", do not bow down:

arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
transliteration: Wailunny yawma 'izil lilmukazzibeen
translation: woe on that Day unto those who give the to the truth!

arabic: فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ
transliteration: Fabi ayyi hadeesim ba'dahoo yu'minoon
translation: In what other tiding, then, will they, after this, believe?

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
transliteration: 'Amma Yatasaa-aloon
translation: ABOUT WHAT do they [most often] ask one another?

arabic: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: 'Anin-nabaa-il 'azeem
translation: About the awesome tiding [of resurrection],

arabic: ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
transliteration: Allazi hum feehi mukh talifoon
translation: on which they [so utterly] disagree.

arabic: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Kallaa sa y'alamoon
translation: Nay, but in time they will come to understand [it]!

arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Thumma kallaa sa y'alamoon
translation: And once again: Nay, but in time they will come to understand!

arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَٰدًۭا
transliteration: Alam naj'alil arda mihaa da
translation: HAVE WE NOT made the earth a resting-place [for you],

arabic: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًۭا
transliteration: Wal jibaala au taada
translation: and the mountains [its] pegs?

arabic: وَخَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا
transliteration: Wa khalaq naakum azwaaja
translation: And We have created you in pairs;

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًۭا
transliteration: Waja'alnan naumakum subata
translation: and We have made your sleep [a symbol of] death

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا
transliteration: Waja'alnal laila libasa
translation: and made the night [its] cloak

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًۭا
transliteration: Waja'alnan nahara ma 'aasha
translation: and made the day [a symbol of] life.

arabic: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًۭا شِدَادًۭا
transliteration: Wa banaina fauqakum sab 'an shi daada
translation: And We have built above you seven firmaments,

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًۭا وَهَّاجًۭا
transliteration: Waja'alna siraajaw wah haaja
translation: and have placed [therein the sun,] a lamp full of blazing splendour.

arabic: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءًۭ ثَجَّاجًۭا
transliteration: Wa anzalna minal m'usiraati maa-an saj-jaaja
translation: And from the wind-driven clouds We send down waters pouring in abundance,

arabic: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّۭا وَنَبَاتًۭا
transliteration: Linukh rija bihee habbaw wana baata
translation: so that We might bring forth thereby grain, and herbs,

arabic: وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا
transliteration: Wa jan naatin alfafa
translation: and gardens dense with follage.

arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتًۭا
transliteration: Inna yaumal-fasli kana miqaata
translation: VERILY, the Day of Distinction [between the true and the false] has indeed its appointed time:

arabic: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًۭا
transliteration: Yauma yun fakhu fis-soori fataa toona afwaaja
translation: the Day when the trumpet [of resurrection] is sounded and you all come forward in multitudes;

arabic: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا
transliteration: Wa futiha tis samaa-u fakaanat abwaaba
translation: and when the skies are opened and become [as wide-flung] gates;

arabic: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا
transliteration: Wa suyyi raatil jibaalu fa kaanat saraaba
translation: and when the mountains are made to vanish as if they had been a mirage.

arabic: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًۭا
transliteration: Inna jahan nama kaanat mirsaada
translation: [On that Day,] verily, hell will lie in wait [for those who deny the truth] –

arabic: لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًۭا
transliteration: Lit taa gheena ma aaba
translation: a goal for all who are wont to transgress the bounds of what is right!

arabic: لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًۭا
transliteration: Laa bitheena feehaa ahqaaba
translation: In it shall they remain for a long time.

arabic: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًۭا وَلَا شَرَابًا
transliteration: Laa ya zooqoona feeha bar daw walaa sharaaba
translation: Neither coolness shall they taste therein nor any [thirst-quenching] drink –

arabic: إِلَّا حَمِيمًۭا وَغَسَّاقًۭا
transliteration: Illa hamee maw-wa ghas saaqa
translation: only burning despair and ice-cold darkness:

arabic: جَزَآءًۭ وِفَاقًا
transliteration: Jazaa-aw wi faaqa
translation: a meet requital [for their sins]!

arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًۭا
transliteration: Innahum kaanu laa yarjoona hisaaba
translation: Behold, they were not expecting to be called to account,

arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابًۭا
transliteration: Wa kazzabu bi aayaa tina kizzaba
translation: having given the lie to Our messages one and all:

arabic: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ كِتَٰبًۭا
transliteration: Wa kulla shai-in ahsai naahu kitaa ba
translation: but We have placed on record every single thing [of what they did].

arabic: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
transliteration: Fa zooqoo falan-nazee dakum ill-laa azaaba
translation: [And so We shall say:] "Taste, then, [the fruit of your evil doings,] for now We shall bestow on you nothing but more and more suffering!"

arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
transliteration: Inna lil mutta qeena mafaaza
translation: [But,] verily for the God-conscious there is supreme fulfilment in store:

arabic: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَٰبًۭا
transliteration: Hadaa-iqa wa a'anaa ba
translation: luxuriant gardens and vinyards,

arabic: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًۭا
transliteration: Wa kaawa 'iba at raaba
translation: and splendid companions well matched,

arabic: وَكَأْسًۭا دِهَاقًۭا
transliteration: Wa ka'san di haaqa
translation: and a cup [of happiness] overflowing.

arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًۭا
transliteration: Laa yasma'oona fiha lagh waw walaa kizzaba
translation: No empty talk will they hear in that [paradise], nor any lie.

arabic: جَزَآءًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًۭا
transliteration: Jazaa-am mir-rabbika ataa-an hisaaba
translation: [All this will be] a reward from thy Sustainer, a gift in accordance with [His Own] reckoning –

arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا
transliteration: Rabbis samaa waati wal ardi wa maa baina humar rahmaani laa yam likoona minhu khi taaba
translation: [a reward from] the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Most Gracious! [And] none shall have it in their power to raise their voices unto Him

arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّۭا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًۭا
transliteration: Yauma yaqoo mur roohu wal malaa-ikatu saf-fal laa yata kalla moona illa man azina lahur rahmaanu wa qaala sawaaba
translation: on the Day when all [human] souls and all the angels will stand up in ranks: none will speak but he to whom the Most Gracious will have given leave; and [everyone] will say [only] what is right.

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
transliteration: Zaalikal yaumul haqqu faman shaa-at ta khaaza ill-laa rabbihi ma-aaba
translation: That will be the Day of Ultimate Truth: whoever wills, then, let him take the path that leads towards his Sustainer!

arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًۭا قَرِيبًۭا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
transliteration: In naa anzar naakum azaaban qareebaiy-yauma yan zurul marr-u maa qaddamat yadaahu wa ya qoolul-kaafiru yaa lai tanee kuntu turaaba
translation: Verily, We have warned you of suffering near at hand - [suffering] on the Day when man shall [clearly] see what his hands have sent ahead, and when he who has denied the truth shall say, "Oh, would that I were mere dust...!"

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرْقًۭا
transliteration: Wan naazi 'aati gharqa
translation: CONSIDER those [stars] that rise only to set,

arabic: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشْطًۭا
transliteration: Wan naa shi taati nashta
translation: and move [in their orbits] with steady motion,

arabic: وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبْحًۭا
transliteration: Wass saabi-haati sabha
translation: and float [through space] with floating serene,

arabic: فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبْقًۭا
transliteration: Fass saabi qaati sabqa
translation: and yet overtake [one another] with swift overtaking:

arabic: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًۭا
transliteration: Fal mu dab-bi raati amra
translation: and thus they fulfil the [Creator's] behest!

arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
transliteration: Yawma tarjufur raajifa
translation: [HENCE, think of] the Day when a violent convulsion will convulse [the world],

arabic: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
transliteration: Tatba'u har raadifa
translation: to be followed by further [convulsions]!

arabic: قُلُوبٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاجِفَةٌ
transliteration: Quloobuny-yau maaiziw-waaji-fa
translation: On that Day will [men's] hearts be throbbing,

arabic: أَبْصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٌۭ
transliteration: Absaa ruhaa khashi'ah
translation: [and] their eyes downcast...

arabic: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
transliteration: Ya qoo loona a-inna lamar doo doona fil haafirah
translation: [And yet,] some say, "What! Are we indeed to be restored to our former state –

arabic: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًۭا نَّخِرَةًۭ
transliteration: Aizaa kunna 'izaa man-nakhirah
translation: even though we may have become [a heap of] crumbling bones?"

arabic: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًۭا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌۭ
transliteration: Qaalu tilka izan karratun khaasirah.
translation: [And] they add, "That, then, would be a return with loss!"

arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ
transliteration: Fa inna ma hiya zajratuw-waahida
translation: [But,] then, that [Last Hour] will be [upon them of a sudden, as if it were] but a single accusing cry -

arabic: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
transliteration: Faizaa hum biss saahirah
translation: and then, lo, they will be fully awakened [to the truth]!

arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
transliteration: Hal ataaka hadeethu Musaa
translation: HAS THE STORY of Moses ever come within thy ken.

arabic: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
transliteration: Iz nadaahu rabbuhu bil waadil-muqad dasi tuwa
translation: Lo! His Sustainer called out to him in the twice-hallowed valley:

arabic: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
transliteration: Izhab ilaa fir'auna innahu taghaa.
translation: "Go unto Pharaoh - for, verily, he has transgressed all bounds of what is right -

arabic: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
transliteration: Faqul hal laka ilaa-an tazakka.
translation: and say [unto him], 'Art thou desirous of attaining to purity?

arabic: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
transliteration: Wa ahdi yaka ila rabbika fatakh sha
translation: [If so,] then I shall guide thee towards [a cognition of] thy Sustainer, so that [henceforth] thou wilt stand in awe [of Him].’"

arabic: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْءَايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
transliteration: Fa araahul-aayatal kubra.
translation: And thereupon he [went to Pharaoh and] made him aware of the great wonder [of God's grace].

arabic: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
transliteration: Fa kazzaba wa asaa.
translation: But [Pharaoh] gave him the lie and rebelliously rejected [all guidance],

arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
transliteration: Thumma adbara yas'aa.
translation: and brusquely turned his back [on Moses];

arabic: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
transliteration: Fa hashara fanada.
translation: and then he gathered [his great ones], and called [unto his people],

arabic: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
transliteration: Faqala ana rabbu kumul-a'laa.
translation: and said, "I am your Lord All-Highest!"

arabic: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
transliteration: Fa-akha zahul laahu nakalal aakhirati wal-oola.
translation: And thereupon God took him to task, [and made him] a warning example in the life to come as well as in this world.

arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la'ibratal limaiy-yaksha
translation: In this, behold, there is a lesson indeed for all who stand in awe [of God].

arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
transliteration: A-antum a shaddu khalqan amis samaa-u banaaha.
translation: [O MEN!] Are you more difficult to create than the heaven which He has built?

arabic: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
transliteration: Raf'a sam kaha fasaw waaha
translation: High has He reared its vault and formed it in accordance with what it was meant to be;

arabic: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
transliteration: Wa aghtasha lailaha wa akhraja duhaaha.
translation: and He has made dark its night and brought forth its light of day.

arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
transliteration: Wal arda b'ada zaalika dahaaha.
translation: And after that, the earth: wide has He spread its expanse,

arabic: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
transliteration: Akhraja minha maa-aha wa mar 'aaha.
translation: and has caused its waters to come out of it, and its pastures,

arabic: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
transliteration: Wal jibala arsaaha.
translation: and has made the mountains firm:

arabic: مَتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
transliteration: Mataa'al lakum wali an 'aamikum.
translation: [all this] as a means of livelihood for you and your animals.

arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
transliteration: Fa-izaa jaaa'atit taaam matul kubraa.
translation: AND SO, when the great overwhelming event [of, resurrection] comes to pass –

arabic: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
transliteration: Yauma Yata zakkarul insaanu ma sa'aa.
translation: on that Day man will [clearly] remember all that he has ever wrought;

arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
transliteration: Wa burrizatil-jaheemu limany-yaraa.
translation: and the blazing fire [of hell] will be lad open before all who [are destined to] see it.

arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
transliteration: Fa ammaa man taghaa.
translation: For, unto him who shall have transgressed the bounds of what is right,

arabic: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
transliteration: Wa aasaral hayaatad dunyaa
translation: and preferred the life of this world [to the good of his soul],

arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
transliteration: Fa innal jaheema hiyal maawaa.
translation: that blazing fire will truly be the goal!

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
transliteration: Wa ammaa man khaafa maqaama Rabbihee wa nahan nafsa 'anil hawaa
translation: But unto him who shall have stood in fear of his Sustainer's Presence, and held back his inner self from base desires,

arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
transliteration: Fa innal jannata hiyal maawaa
translation: paradise will truly be the goal!

arabic: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
transliteration: Yas'aloonaka 'anis saa'ati ayyaana mursaahaa
translation: THEY WILL ASK thee [O Prophet] about the Last Hour: "When will it come to pass?"

arabic: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
transliteration: Feema anta min zikraahaa
translation: [But] how couldst thou tell anything about it,

arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
transliteration: Ilaa Rabbika muntahaa haa
translation: [seeing that] with thy Sustainer alone rests the beginning and the end [of all knowledge] thereof?

arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
transliteration: Innamaaa anta munziru maiy yakshaahaa
translation: Thou art but [sent] to warn those who stand in awe of it.

arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
transliteration: Ka annahum Yawma yarawnahaa lam yalbasooo illaa 'ashiyyatan aw duhaahaa
translation: On the Day when they behold it, [it will seem to them] as if they had tarried [in this world] no longer than one evening or [one night, ending with] its morn!

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
transliteration: 'Abasa wa tawallaa.
translation: HE FROWNED and turned away

arabic: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
transliteration: An jaa-ahul 'a-maa
translation: because the blind man approached him!

arabic: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
transliteration: Wa maa yudreeka la'allahu yaz zakkaa.
translation: Yet for all thou didst know, [O Muhammad,] he might perhaps have grown in purity,

arabic: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
transliteration: Au yaz zak karu fatanfa 'ahuz zikraa.
translation: or have been reminded [of the truth], and helped by this reminder.

arabic: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
transliteration: Amma manis taghnaa
translation: Now as for him who believes himself to be self-sufficient

arabic: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
transliteration: Fa-anta lahu tasaddaa
translation: to him didst thou give thy whole attention,

arabic: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
transliteration: Wa ma 'alaika allaa yaz zakka.
translation: although thou art not accountable for his failure to attain to purity;

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
transliteration: Wa amma man jaa-aka yas'a
translation: but as for him who came unto thee full of eagerness

arabic: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
transliteration: Wahuwa yakhshaa,
translation: and in awe [of God]

arabic: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
transliteration: Fa-anta 'anhu talah haa.
translation: him didst thou disregard!

arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌۭ
transliteration: Kalla innaha tazkirah
translation: NAY, VERILY, these [messages] are but a reminder:

arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
transliteration: Faman shaa a zakarah
translation: and so, whoever is willing may remember Him

arabic: فِى صُحُفٍۢ مُّكَرَّمَةٍۢ
transliteration: Fi suhufim mukar rama,
translation: in [the light of His] revelations blest with dignity,

arabic: مَّرْفُوعَةٍۢ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
transliteration: Marfoo'atim mutah hara,
translation: lofty and pure,

arabic: بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍۢ
transliteration: Bi'aidee safara
translation: [borne] by the hands of messengers

arabic: كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍۢ
transliteration: Kiraamim bararah.
translation: noble and most virtuous.

arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ
transliteration: Qutilal-insanu maa akfarah.
translation: [But only too often] man destroys himself: how stubbornly does he deny the truth!

arabic: مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
transliteration: Min aiyyi shai-in Khalaq
translation: [Does man ever consider] out of what substance [God] creates him?

arabic: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
transliteration: Min nutfah; khalaqahu faqad-darah.
translation: Out of a drop of sperm He creates him, and thereupon determines his nature,

arabic: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
transliteration: Thummas sabeela yas-sarah
translation: and then makes it easy for him to go through life;

arabic: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ
transliteration: Thumma amatahu fa-aqbarah
translation: and in the end He causes him to die and brings him to the grave;

arabic: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
transliteration: Thumma iza shaa-a ansharah
translation: and then, if it be His will, He shall raise him again to life,

arabic: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
transliteration: Kalla lamma yaqdi maa amarah.
translation: Nay, but [man] has never yet fulfilled what He has enjoined upon him!

arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
transliteration: Falyanzuril insanu ilaa ta-amih
translation: Let man, then, consider [the sources of] his food:

arabic: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّۭا
transliteration: Anna sabab nalmaa-a sabba.
translation: [how it is] that We pour down water, pouring it down abundantly;

arabic: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّۭا
transliteration: Thumma sha qaqnal-arda shaqqa.
translation: and then We cleave the earth [with new growth], cleaving it asunder,

arabic: فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّۭا
transliteration: Fa ambatna feeha habba
translation: and thereupon We cause grain to grow out of it,

arabic: وَعِنَبًۭا وَقَضْبًۭا
transliteration: Wa 'inabaw-wa qadba
translation: and vines and edible plants,

arabic: وَزَيْتُونًۭا وَنَخْلًۭا
transliteration: Wa zaitoonaw wanakh la'
translation: and olive trees and date-palms,

arabic: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًۭا
transliteration: Wa hadaa-iqa ghulba
translation: and gardens dense with foliage,

arabic: وَفَٰكِهَةًۭ وَأَبًّۭا
transliteration: Wa faki hataw-wa abba.
translation: and fruits and herbage,

arabic: مَّتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
transliteration: Mata'al-lakum wa li-an'amikum.
translation: for you and for your animals to enjoy.

arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
transliteration: Faiza jaa-atis saakhah.
translation: AND SO, when the piercing call [of resurrection] is heard

arabic: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
transliteration: Yauma yafir-rul mar-u min akheeh
translation: on a Day when everyone will [want to] flee from his brother,

arabic: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
transliteration: Wa ummihee wa abeeh
translation: and from his mother and father,

arabic: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
transliteration: Wa sahi batihee wa baneeh.
translation: and from his spouse and his children:

arabic: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ شَأْنٌۭ يُغْنِيهِ
transliteration: Likul limri-im-minuhm yaumaa-izin shaa nuy-yughneeh
translation: on that Day, to every one of them will his own state be of sufficient concern.

arabic: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ مُّسْفِرَةٌۭ
transliteration: Wujoo huny-yauma-izim-musfira;
translation: Some faces will on that Day be bright with happiness,

arabic: ضَاحِكَةٌۭ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌۭ
transliteration: Dahi katum mustab shirah
translation: laughing, rejoicing at glad tidings.

arabic: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌۭ
transliteration: Wa wujoohuy yauma-izin 'alaiha ghabar a
translation: And some faces will on that Day with dust be covered,

arabic: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
transliteration: Tarhaquha qatarah.
translation: with darkness overspread:

arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ
transliteration: Ulaa-ika humul-kafa ratul-fajarah.
translation: these, these will be the ones who denied the truth and were immersed in iniquity!

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
transliteration: Izash shamsu kuwwirat
translation: WHEN THE SUN is shrouded in darkness,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
transliteration: Wa izan nujoomun kadarat
translation: and when the stars lose their light,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
transliteration: Wa izal jibaalu suyyirat
translation: and when the mountains are made to vanish,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
transliteration: Wa izal 'ishaaru 'uttilat
translation: and when she-camels big with young, about to give birth, are left untended,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
transliteration: Wa izal wuhooshu hushirat
translation: and when all beasts are gathered together,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
transliteration: Wa izal bihaaru sujjirat
translation: and when the seas boil over,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
transliteration: Wa izan nufoosu zuwwijat
translation: and when all human beings are coupled [with their deeds],

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ
transliteration: Wa izal maw'oodatu su'ilat
translation: and when the girl-child that was buried alive is made to ask

arabic: بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍۢ قُتِلَتْ
transliteration: Bi ayyi zambin qutilat
translation: for what crime she had been slain,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
transliteration: Wa izas suhufu nushirat
translation: and when the scrolls [of men's deeds] are unfolded,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ
transliteration: Wa izas samaaa'u kushitat
translation: and when heaven is laid bare,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
transliteration: Wa izal jaheemu su'-'irat
translation: and when the blazing fire [of hell] is kindled bright,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
transliteration: Wa izal jannatu uzlifat
translation: and when paradise is brought into view:

arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ
transliteration: 'Alimat nafsum maaa ahdarat
translation: [on that Day] every human being will come to know what he has prepared [for himself].

arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ
transliteration: Falaaa uqsimu bil khunnas
translation: BUT NAY! I call to witness the revolving stars,

arabic: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ
transliteration: Al jawaaril kunnas
translation: the planets that run their course and set,

arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
transliteration: Wallaili izaa 'as'as
translation: and the night as it darkly falls,

arabic: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
transliteration: Wassubhi izaa tanaffas
translation: and the morn as it softly breathes:

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
transliteration: Innahoo laqawlu rasoolin kareem
translation: behold, this [divine writ] is indeed the [inspired] word of a noble apostle,

arabic: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍۢ
transliteration: Zee quwwatin 'inda zil 'arshi makeen
translation: with strength endowed, secure with Him who in almightiness is enthroned

arabic: مُّطَاعٍۢ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍۢ
transliteration: Mutaa'in samma ameen
translation: [the word] of one to be heeded, and worthy of trust!

arabic: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍۢ
transliteration: Wa maa saahibukum bimajnoon
translation: For, this fellow-man of yours is not a madman:

arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
transliteration: Wa laqad ra aahu bilufuqil mubeen
translation: he truly beheld [the angel - beheld] him on the clear horizon;

arabic: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍۢ
transliteration: Wa maa huwa 'alal ghaibi bidaneen
translation: and he is not one to begrudge others the knowledge [of whatever has been revealed to him] out of that which is beyond the reach of human Perception.

arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍۢ
transliteration: Wa maa huwa biqawli shaitaanir rajeem
translation: Nor is this [message] the word of any satanic force accursed.

arabic: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
transliteration: Fa ayna tazhaboon
translation: Whither, then, will you go?

arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
transliteration: In huwa illaa zikrul lil'aalameen
translation: This [message] is no less than a reminder to all mankind –

arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
transliteration: Liman shaaa'a minkum ai yastaqeem
translation: to everyone of you who wills to walk a straight way.

arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
transliteration: Wa maa tashaaa'oona illaaa ai yashaaa 'al laahu Rabbul 'Aalameen
translation: But you cannot will it unless God, the Sustainer of all the worlds, wills [to show you that way].

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
transliteration: Izas samaaa'un fatarat
translation: WHEN THE SKY is cleft asunder,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
transliteration: Wa izal kawaakibun tasarat
translation: and when the stars are scattered,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
transliteration: Wa izal bihaaru fujjirat
translation: and when the seas burst beyond their bounds,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
transliteration: Wa izal qubooru bu'sirat
translation: and when the graves are overturned –

arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
transliteration: 'Alimat nafsum maa qaddamat wa akhkharat
translation: every human being will [at last] comprehend, what he has sent ahead and what he has held back [in this world].

arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
transliteration: Yaaa ayyuhal insaaanu maa gharraka bi Rabbikal kareem
translation: O MAN! What is it that lures thee away from thy bountiful Sustainer,

arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
transliteration: Allazee khalaqaka fasaw waaka fa'adalak
translation: who has created thee, and formed thee in accordance with what thou art meant' to be, and shaped thy nature in just proportions,

arabic: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
transliteration: Feee ayye sooratim maa shaaa'a rakkabak
translation: having put thee together in whatever form He willed [thee to have]?

arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
transliteration: Kalla bal tukazziboona bid deen
translation: Nay, [O men,] but you [are lured away from God whenever you are tempted to] give the lie to [God’s] Judgment!

arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَٰفِظِينَ
transliteration: Wa inna 'alaikum lahaa fizeen
translation: And yet, verily, there are ever-watchful forces over you,

arabic: كِرَامًۭا كَٰتِبِينَ
transliteration: Kiraaman kaatibeen
translation: noble, recording,

arabic: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
transliteration: Ya'lamoona ma taf'aloon
translation: aware of whatever you do!

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍۢ
transliteration: Innal abraara lafee na'eem
translation: Behold, [in the life to come] the truly virtuous: will indeed be in bliss,

arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍۢ
transliteration: Wa innal fujjaara lafee jaheem
translation: whereas, behold, the wicked will indeed be in a blazing fire –

arabic: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
transliteration: Yaslawnahaa Yawmad Deen
translation: [a fire] which they shall enter on Judgment Day,

arabic: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
transliteration: Wa maa hum 'anhaa bighaaa 'ibeen
translation: and which they shall not [be able to] evade.

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
transliteration: Wa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen
translation: And what could make thee conceive what that Judgment Day will be?

arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
transliteration: Summa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen
translation: And once again: What could make thee conceive what that Judgment Day will be?

arabic: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ
transliteration: Yawma laa tamliku nafsul linafsin shai'anw walamru yawma'izil lillaah
translation: [It will be] a Day when no human being shall be of the least avail to another human being: for on that Day [it will become manifest that] all sovereignty is God's alone.

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
transliteration: Wailul lil mutaffifeen
translation: WOE UNTO THOSE who give short measure:

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
transliteration: Allazeena izak taaloo 'alan naasi yastawfoon
translation: those who, when they are to receive their due from [other] people, demand that it be given in full –

arabic: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa izaa kaaloohum aw wazanoohum yukhsiroon
translation: but when they have to measure or weigh whatever they owe to others, give less than what is due!

arabic: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
transliteration: Alaa yazunnu ulaaa'ika annahum mab'oosoon
translation: Do they not know that they are bound to be raised from the dead

arabic: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
transliteration: Li Yawmin 'Azeem
translation: [and called to account] on an awesome Day –

arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
transliteration: Yawma yaqoomun naasu li Rabbil 'aalameen
translation: the Day when all men shall stand before the Sustainer of all the worlds?

arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
transliteration: Kallaaa inna kitaabal fujjaari lafee Sijjeen
translation: NAY, VERILY, the record of the wicked is indeed [set down] in a mode inescapable!

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌۭ
transliteration: Wa maa adraaka maa Sijjeen
translation: And what could make thee conceive what that that mode inescapable will be?

arabic: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
transliteration: Kitaabum marqoom
translation: A record [indelibly] inscribed!

arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
transliteration: Wailuny yawma'izil lil mukazzibeen
translation: Woe on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth –

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
transliteration: Allazeena yukazziboona bi yawmid deen
translation: those who give the lie to the [coming of] Judgment Day:

arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
transliteration: Wa maa yukazzibu biheee illaa kullu mu'tadin aseem
translation: for, none gives the lie to it but such as are wont to transgress against all that is [and are] immersed in sin:

arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
transliteration: Izaa tutlaa'alaihi aayaatunaa qaala asaateerul awwaleen
translation: [and so,] whenever Our messages are conveyed to them, they but say, "Fables of ancient times!"

arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
transliteration: Kallaa bal raana 'alaa quloobihim maa kaanoo yaksiboon
translation: Nay, but their hearts are corroded by all [the evil] that they were wont to do!

arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
transliteration: Kallaaa innahum 'ar Rabbihim yawma'izil lamah jooboon
translation: Nay, verily, from [the grace of] their Sustainer shall they on that Day be debarred;

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
transliteration: Summa innahum lasaa lul jaheem
translation: and then, behold, they shall enter the blazing fire

arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
transliteration: Summa yuqaalu haazal lazee kuntum bihee tukazziboon
translation: and be told: "This is the [very thing] to which you were wont to give the lie!"

arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
transliteration: Kallaaa inna kitaabal abraari lafee'Illiyyeen
translation: NAY, VERILY - the record of the truly virtuous is [set down] in a mode most lofty!

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
transliteration: Wa maaa adraaka maa 'Illiyyoon
translation: And what could make thee conceive what that mode most lofty will be?

arabic: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
transliteration: Kitaabum marqoom
translation: A record [indelibly] inscribed,

arabic: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
transliteration: Yashhadu hul muqarra boon
translation: witnessed~ by all who have [ever] been drawn close unto God.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
transliteration: Innal abraara lafee Na'eem
translation: Behold, [in the life to come] the truly virtuous will indeed be in bliss:

arabic: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
transliteration: 'Alal araaa'iki yanzuroon
translation: [resting on couches, they will look up [to God]:

arabic: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
transliteration: Ta'rifu fee wujoohihim nadratan na'eem
translation: upon their faces thou wilt see the brightness of bliss.

arabic: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍۢ مَّخْتُومٍ
transliteration: Yusqawna mir raheeqim makhtoom
translation: They will be given a drink of pure wine whereon the seal [of God] will have been set,

arabic: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
transliteration: Khitaamuhoo misk; wa fee zaalika falyatanaafasil Mutanaafisoon
translation: pouring forth with a fragrance of musk. To that [wine of paradise], then, let all such aspire as [are willing to] aspire to things of high account:

arabic: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
transliteration: Wa mizaajuhoo min Tasneem
translation: for it is composed of all that is most exalting

arabic: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
transliteration: 'Ainaiy yashrabu bihal muqarraboon
translation: a source [of bliss] whereof those who are drawn close unto God shall drink.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
transliteration: Innal lazeena ajramoo kaanoo minal lazeena aamanoo yadhakoon
translation: BEHOLD, those who have abandoned themselves to sin are wont to laugh at such as have attained to faith

arabic: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
transliteration: Wa izaa marroo bihim yataghaamazoon
translation: and whenever they pass by them, they wink at one another [derisively];

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
transliteration: Wa izan qalabooo ilaaa ahlihimun qalaboo fakiheen
translation: and whenever they return to people of their own kind, they return full of jests;

arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
transliteration: Wa izaa ra awhum qaalooo inna haaa'ulaaa'i ladaaal loon
translation: and whenever they see those [who believe,] they say, "Behold, these [people] have indeed gone astray!"

arabic: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَٰفِظِينَ
transliteration: Wa maaa ursiloo 'alaihim haafizeen
translation: And, withal, they have no call to watch over [the beliefs of] others...

arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
transliteration: Fal yawmal lazeena aamanoo minal kuffaari yadhakoon
translation: But on the Day [of Judgment], they who had attained to faith will [be able to] laugh at the [erstwhile] deniers of the truth:

arabic: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
transliteration: 'Alal araaa'iki yanzuroon
translation: [for, resting in paradise] on couches, they will look on [and say to themselves]:

arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
transliteration: Hal suwwibal kuffaaru maa kaanoo yaf'aloon
translation: "Are these deniers of the truth being [thus] requited for [aught but] what they were wont to do?"

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
transliteration: Izas samaaa'un shaqqat
translation: WHEN THE SKY is split asunder,

arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
transliteration: Wa azinat li Rabbihaa wa huqqat
translation: obeying its Sustainer, as in truth it must;

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
transliteration: Wa izal ardu muddat
translation: and when the earth is leveled,

arabic: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
transliteration: Wa alqat maa feehaa wa takhallat
translation: and casts forth whatever is in it, and becomes utterly void,

arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
transliteration: Wa azinat li Rabbihaa wa huqqat
translation: obeying its Sustainer, as in truth it must -:

arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًۭا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
transliteration: Yaaa ayyuhal insaanu innaka kaadihun ilaa Rabbika kad han famulaaqeeh
translation: [then,] O man - thou [that] hast, verily, been toiling towards thy Sustainer in painful toil - then shalt thou meet Him!

arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
transliteration: Fa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo biyameenih
translation: And as for him whose record shall be placed in his right hand,

arabic: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًۭا يَسِيرًۭا
